title: Self-improving data synthesis can scale embedding models across domains and tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.14730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting embedding models to new tasks requires training data that reflect task-specific information needs and relevance criteria. However, manual data design is costly and difficult to scale. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a novel retrieval data synthesis method whose self-improvement loop iteratively refines reusable synthesis instructions using feedback on trial outputs. This process requires only an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs. Experiments across 24 retrieval datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate the effectiveness of the synthesized data. These data also improve widely used, strong embedding models on tasks with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement enhances retrieval on all six evaluated tasks, outperforming human calibration on four. translated_title: 自改进的数据合成可跨领域、跨任务扩展嵌入模型
translated_abstract: 将嵌入模型适应到新任务需要能反映任务特定信息需求和相关性标准的训练数据。然而，人工设计数据成本高昂且难以规模化。本文提出了SYNTRA，一种新颖的检索数据合成方法，其自改进循环利用对试验输出的反馈来迭代优化可复用的合成指令。该过程仅需一个无标注语料库和少量相关的查询-文档对。在横跨15个领域的24个检索数据集上的实验证明了合成数据的有效性。这些数据还能在有无现有标注训练集的任务上提升广泛使用的强嵌入模型的性能。自改进在全部六个评估任务上都提升了检索效果，并在其中四个任务上超越了人工校准。此外，随着训练数据集规模扩展到初始大小的32倍，MS MARCO上的检索性能仍持续提升。
tldr: 提出了SYNTRA自改进检索数据合成方法，仅需无标注语料库和少量查询-文档对，通过自改进循环迭代优化合成指令，在多数任务上超越人工校准，并使嵌入模型随数据规模扩展在15个领域持续提升性能。
